content: This information is not intended to serve as personalized medical advice and should not replace the guidance of your healthcare professional. Always consult your healthcare provider for comprehensive information about this product and your specific health needs. Precautions: Before taking levonorgestrel, inform your doctor or pharmacist if you are allergic to it, to other progestins (such as norethindrone), or if you have any other allergies. This product may contain inactive ingredients that could cause allergic reactions or other complications. This medication may cause dizziness. Alcohol or marijuana (cannabis) can exacerbate this effect. Avoid driving, operating machinery, or engaging in activities requiring alertness until you are sure you can do so safely. Limit alcoholic beverages. This medication must not be used during pregnancy. While this medication passes into breast milk, it is unlikely to harm a nursing infant. Drug Interactions: Drug interactions can alter the effectiveness of your medications or increase the risk of serious side effects. This document does not include all possible drug interactions. Maintain a list of all products you use (including prescription, non-prescription drugs, and herbal products) and share it with your doctor and pharmacist. Certain drugs may reduce the effectiveness of emergency birth control by decreasing the levels of birth control hormones in your body, potentially leading to pregnancy. Examples include griseofulvin, modafinil, rifamycins (such as rifampin, rifabutin), St. John’s wort, drugs used to treat seizures (such as barbiturates, carbamazepine, felbamate, phenytoin, primidone, topiramate), and certain HIV drugs (such as nelfinavir, nevirapine), among others. Overdose: Overdose with this medication is highly unlikely. However, if someone has overdosed and exhibits severe symptoms such as loss of consciousness or difficulty breathing, call 911 immediately. Otherwise, contact a poison control center right away. U.S. residents can call 1-800-222-1222, and Canadian residents can call 1-844-764-7669. Storage: Store this medication at room temperature, away from light and moisture. Do not store it in the bathroom. Do not flush medications down the toilet or pour them into a drain unless instructed to do so. Properly discard this product when it is expired or no longer needed. Important Information: This document provides a summary and does not contain all possible information about this product. It does not guarantee that this product is safe, effective, or appropriate for you. This information is not a substitute for individualized medical advice. Always consult your healthcare professional for complete information about this product and your specific health needs. Formulary Information: Adding plans allows you to compare the formulary status of this drug to others in the same class. To view formulary information, first create a list of plans. Your list will be saved and can be edited at any time. Individual plans may vary, and formulary information is subject to change. Contact the applicable plan provider for the most current information.
